subject: Discovery call - next steps & demo scheduling

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery call - next steps & demo scheduling

Hi Samir -

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Key priorities you mentioned: reducing per-request latency, predictable throughput for batch jobs, and stronger isolation for PII workloads.
- Primary constraints: Q3 procurement window, existing infra on GCP, and SOC 2 requirement for audit logs.

Next step: technical deep-dive + demo where Vivek (our solutions engineer) will walk through the runtime, routing policies, and a short hands-on on your sample workload. Could you confirm who will join from your side and which of these slots works for you?

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 26 May - 10:00 - 10:45am PT
- Wed 27 May - 2:00 - 2:45pm PT
- Thu 28 May - 11:00 - 11:45am PT

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we'll accommodate. I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link once you confirm attendees/time.

Attached is a short agenda for the demo.

Thanks -
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference

Attachment: acme_redwood_demo_agenda.pdf

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call - next steps & demo scheduling

Thanks Marissa - really helpful recap. Wed 27 May 2:00pm PT works best for us. Attendees from Acme: 

- Samir Khan (CTO)
- Emily Rogers (Platform PM)
- Jason Lee (Infra Eng) - may be on camera for the hands-on

A couple quick asks before the demo: can Vivek cover the GCP integration story and any recommended quantization profiles for our Mistral-based models? Also please include a Zoom link in the invite.
